name: GAIB AID
oneLiner: AID is GAIB's centralized dollar stablecoin, minted 1:1 against USDC, USDT, and other approved stables, backed by a mix of T-Bills and accepted stablecoins.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills and accepted stablecoins (USDC, USDT, and other approved stable assets); staking into sAID is the separate route into GAIB's AI infrastructure financing portfolio
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and burn against accepted stablecoins through GAIB AID contracts. Issuer documentation describes direct redemption for whitelisted partners and app/DEX trading for regular users. At Ethereum block 26099923 on 2026-10-01, the issuer-listed Ethereum redeemer 0x52323f33551188f170d8de14fe8d8423a839629d uses redeem(uint256) to burn caller AID and transfer Ethereum USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 after a 10-bps fee, subject to its daily redemption limit, actual USDC balance and AID burn authorization. This atomic contract path is distinct from sAID's funded withdrawal queue and does not establish holder eligibility or an executable capacity certificate.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: GAIB documentation and dated transparency classify AID as a fiat-cash token, but do not disclose current AID-specific assurance and reconciliation terms; that risk boundary remains explicitly unresolved.
